_about: Step 16: Finebase HQ's sample obligations, readiness rules and risks. Every one is a sample: real due days, evidence and owners come from the company. Monthly obligations fall due on a day of the month for the month before; the renewal falls due when the contract's verified term ends. Each required item is proven by a verified fact with this predicate (and, for monthly ones, a fact about that month).
